name: Satyr

reactions.name: Reflexive Antennae
reactions.text: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae. Sahuagin Sahuagin Warrior

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The sahuagin has Advantage on at- tack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.text: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.text: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Aquatic Charge
actions.text: The sahuagin swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see. Salamander Salamander
